instruction: Candid black-and-white medium-full shot of a couple on a city embankment. On the right, the bearded man in a dark coat (R1) leans against a stone ledge, looking down. On the left, the woman in a black cap and long scarf (R2) hugs him closely, looking up with a joyful smile. The shot captures their full-body embrace against a soft-focus urban background in monochrome.
elements: R2 hugs R1 closely rather than R1 being described as the one hugging R2
R1 leans against a stone ledge while R2 is the person embracing him
R2 looks up joyfully toward R1 while R1 looks down
R1 is supported by or leaning on the stone ledge during the contact
The couple is on a city embankment

questions.q: Is R1 the person leaning against the stone ledge while R2 embraces him, rather than R2 leaning on the ledge while R1 embraces her?
questions.element: R1 leans against the stone ledge while R2 hugs him

questions.q: Does R2 look up toward R1 with a joyful smile while R1 looks down, rather than the other way around?
questions.element: R2 looks up joyfully while R1 looks down

questions.q: Is R2 positioned close against R1 in the embrace while R1 remains the person being leaned into?
questions.element: R2 is the close-embracing partner and R1 is the partner receiving the embrace
